profiles.Inventory: Collects configuration inventory without issuing most security conclusions.
profiles.Validation: Adds non-destructive validation (e.g. iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy). Requires an authorized, in-window engagement.
profiles.AdversarySimulation: Requires explicit adversary-simulation approval; this framework remains read-only and does not execute exploitation.

controls.title: Root account has MFA enabled
controls.expectedState: The account root user has an MFA device enabled.

controls.title: Root account has no active access keys
controls.expectedState: The root user has no active access keys.

controls.title: Root account is not used for routine activity
controls.expectedState: The root user has not been used within the recent-activity threshold.

controls.title: IAM password policy meets strength requirements
controls.expectedState: A password policy exists requiring length >= 14 and complexity.

controls.title: Console users have MFA enabled
controls.expectedState: Every IAM user with a console password has an MFA device.

controls.title: Access keys are rotated within policy
controls.expectedState: Active access keys are younger than the rotation threshold (default 90 days).

controls.title: Unused credentials are disabled
controls.expectedState: Passwords and access keys unused beyond the inactivity threshold are disabled.

controls.title: No policies grant full administrative privileges
controls.expectedState: No customer-managed policy allows Action:* over Resource:* .

controls.title: IAM Access Analyzer is enabled
controls.expectedState: At least one IAM Access Analyzer analyzer is active in the account.

controls.title: Principals do not hold known privilege-escalation permissions
controls.expectedState: No non-admin principal is granted permissions enabling IAM privilege escalation (e.g. iam:CreatePolicyVersion, iam:PassRole + compute create, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode).

controls.title: Account-level S3 Block Public Access is enabled
controls.expectedState: All four account-level S3 Block Public Access settings are enabled.

controls.title: Buckets are not publicly accessible
controls.expectedState: No bucket policy or ACL grants public read/write access.

controls.title: Buckets enforce default encryption
controls.expectedState: Every bucket has default server-side encryption configured.

controls.title: Buckets enforce TLS-only access
controls.expectedState: Bucket policies deny requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.

controls.title: Instances require IMDSv2
controls.expectedState: Every running instance sets HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2).

controls.title: EBS encryption by default is enabled
controls.expectedState: EBS encryption-by-default is enabled in each assessed region.

controls.title: Instances are not exposed with public IPs on sensitive ports
controls.expectedState: Instances with public IPs are not reachable on administrative ports from 0.0.0.0/0.

controls.title: Security groups do not allow ingress to admin ports from anywhere
controls.expectedState: No security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ingress to ports 22 or 3389.

controls.title: Default security groups restrict all traffic
controls.expectedState: Every default security group has no inbound or outbound rules.

controls.title: VPC flow logging is enabled
controls.expectedState: Every VPC in scope has an active flow log.

controls.title: A multi-region CloudTrail trail is enabled
controls.expectedState: At least one multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging and enabled.

controls.title: CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
controls.expectedState: CloudTrail trails enable log file integrity validation.

controls.title: CloudTrail logs are encrypted with KMS
controls.expectedState: CloudTrail trails encrypt logs with a KMS CMK.

controls.title: AWS Config is enabled
controls.expectedState: AWS Config recorder is enabled and recording in each assessed region.

controls.title: GuardDuty is enabled
controls.expectedState: Amazon GuardDuty has an active detector in each assessed region.

controls.title: Customer-managed KMS keys have rotation enabled
controls.expectedState: Enabled customer-managed symmetric CMKs have automatic rotation on.

controls.title: RDS instances encrypt data at rest
controls.expectedState: Every RDS instance has storage encryption enabled.

controls.title: RDS instances are not publicly accessible
controls.expectedState: No RDS instance has PubliclyAccessible set to true.

controls.title: Account break-glass procedure is documented
controls.expectedState: A documented, tested break-glass procedure exists for root and privileged access.
